name: TriMUI Smart Pro
summary: TriMUI's 4.96-inch A133P-based handheld with a fully laminated square IPS display. Stock firmware is TrimUI's own OS; KNULLI's guide uses ADB on the stock OS to pull files for joystick calibration. KNULLI, muOS and spruceOS support available.
openByDesign: KNULLI and muOS boot from an SD card; the stock OS returns when the card is removed

variants.notes: Large 4.96-inch fully laminated IPS display. Allwinner A133P (A133+) @1.8 GHz with PowerVR GE8300 GPU. RGB charging status light, RGB status indicator, RGB dual-joystick ambient light. Two USB-C ports: bottom (charging + OTG), top (USB host for controller). Battery life claimed 5 hours. Emulator support includes PS1, GBA, GBC, GB, FC, SFC, MD, MAME, CPS1-3, NEOGEO, PCE, NGP, WSC, NDS, N64, DC, PSP, SS (20+ formats). Dual-controller support with WiFi online two-player battles.

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image (knulli-a133-trimui-smart-pro); boots from SD card. Requires Joystick calibration via stock OS ADB pull + KNULLI overlay/custom.sh.
homebrew.summary: Retro gaming OS for the TriMUI Smart Pro based on Allwinner A133. Boots from a prepared SD card.

compatibility.note: KNULLI publishes an A133 image for the Smart Pro with Allwinner BSP and pvrsrvkm GL driver. Joystick calibration via stock OS is required in some cases.

requirements: A compatible TriMUI Smart Pro unit.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
ADB platform tools for joystick calibration (required in rare cases).
warnings: Joystick calibration may be needed — follow the stock-OS calibration + ADB pull procedure before or after installing KNULLI.
If using overlay for calibration persistence, delete and reapply the overlay on every system update.

homebrew.name: muOS (MustardOS)
homebrew.firmware: Per-model A133 image (muOS 2606.0 Andromeda); written to an SD card with an image writer.
homebrew.summary: Lightweight Linux OS (MustardOS frontend plus RetroArch cores) for the TrimUI Smart Pro. The image is written to an SD card; the stock system is untouched.

compatibility.note: muOS 2606.0 lists the TrimUI Smart Pro on its supported-devices page.

requirements: A TrimUI Smart Pro from muOS's supported-devices page.
An SD card of 16 GB or larger.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer that reads .img.gz files.
warnings: muOS writes a whole-disk image; the target card is erased.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Frontend on top of the stock OS.
homebrew.summary: Custom Python-based frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported TriMUI devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the TriMUI Smart Pro with 'Stable' support status.

requirements: A compatible TriMUI Smart Pro unit.
A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.
